historical_references.reference: Iniyaa was an early Chola queen of the Chola Empire in South India, who is believed to have ruled during the late 9th and early 10th centuries CE. She is best known for her role in the expansion of the Chola Empire and the construction of numerous temples, including the important temple of Lord Shiva at Thanjavur.

Another reference to Iniyaa comes from the Tamil classic text, the Tirumurai, which contains hymns composed by the 12 Alvar saints of Tamil Shaivism. The text mentions a queen named Iniyaa, who is said to have renounced her royal duties and became a devotee of Lord Shiva, worshipping him at the temple of Thiruvanaikkovil.
